cat:advisory.cat:title: Observe water distribution
cat:advisory.cat:description: Some field sections appear wetter or drier than nearby sections.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Compare several safe observation points and note water conditions and dates. Ask a local qualified advisor to assess the field.
cat:advisory.cat:source: Educational sample prepared for the RythuSahayak student project; not an official advisory.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Record leaf discoloration
cat:advisory.cat:description: Leaves show patches of discoloration that appear different from surrounding plants.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Record where the changes occur and photograph representative plants if practical. Seek local expert confirmation before taking action.
cat:advisory.cat:source: Educational sample; symptoms alone do not establish a diagnosis.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Check for changes on leaves
cat:advisory.cat:description: Leaf edges or surfaces show visible changes on some plants.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Check multiple plants and note how widespread the visible changes are. Do not identify a pest from a single sign; ask a qualified local advisor.
cat:advisory.cat:source: Educational sample for observation practice; no treatment prescription is provided.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Keep a field observation log
cat:advisory.cat:description: Field conditions and plant appearance can vary across locations and over time.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Write down the date, field section, and visible observations consistently. Share the notes with a qualified advisor when requesting help.
cat:advisory.cat:source: General educational sample; not an official recommendation.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Note uneven plant growth
cat:advisory.cat:description: Plants in one part of a field appear to grow differently from plants elsewhere.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Compare plant growth and visible soil or water conditions across several locations. Avoid assuming a nutrient cause without local assessment.
cat:advisory.cat:source: Educational observation sample; field-specific assessment is needed.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Track changes on leaves and stems
cat:advisory.cat:description: Visible marks or changes appear on leaves or stems of some plants.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Note which plant parts are affected and whether nearby plants show similar signs. Consult a qualified local agricultural advisor for identification.
cat:advisory.cat:source: Educational sample; descriptions are not a diagnosis.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Observe soil moisture differences
cat:advisory.cat:description: Soil moisture seems to differ between parts of a plot.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Compare soil conditions at several representative points using safe, consistent observations. Ask a local advisor to interpret the differences.
cat:advisory.cat:source: General educational sample; not crop-specific irrigation instructions.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Look for patterns of leaf damage
cat:advisory.cat:description: Visible leaf damage occurs on a small or unevenly distributed number of plants.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Record affected areas and compare several plants. Seek qualified local identification before choosing any management response.
cat:advisory.cat:source: Educational observation sample; no pesticide advice is intended.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Compare plant color across the plot
cat:advisory.cat:description: Plant color appears uneven between rows or field sections.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Note the pattern, crop stage, and visible field differences. A qualified advisor can help assess possible causes before any input is applied.
cat:advisory.cat:source: Educational sample; color differences can have multiple causes.

cat:advisory.cat:title: Observe stand consistency
cat:advisory.cat:description: Plant spacing or emergence looks less consistent in some plot areas.
cat:advisory.cat:recommendation: Record which areas differ and note relevant field conditions. Consult a local expert before drawing conclusions about establishment.
cat:advisory.cat:source: General educational sample; not a field diagnosis.
